design_detail: Initiative to the FBiH government to introduce a wealth tax (first sent c. 2016, rejected; renewal announced 2018)
quote_original: Prije dvije godine uputili smo inicijativu za uvođenje poreza na bogatstvo ali je Vlada FBiH to odbila
quote_en: Two years ago we sent an initiative to introduce a wealth tax, but the FBiH Government rejected it.
source_title: SDP iz BiH želi uvesti porez na bogatstvo
grading_note: Formal party initiative to the entity government naming a wealth tax; no rate or threshold given, and the date of the first initiative is only 'two years ago'.

design_detail: Announced a renewed SDP initiative to the FBiH government; wealth tax to go into SDP's 'Plan 10' if refused
quote_original: smatramo da je porez na bogatstvo nužan instrument solidarnosti
quote_en: we consider the wealth tax a necessary instrument of solidarity
source_title: SDP iz BiH želi uvesti porez na bogatstvo
grading_note: Own statement by the SDP delegate in the House of Peoples naming the wealth tax; no rate or threshold.

design_detail: Analysis 'Porez na bogatstvo u Bosni i Hercegovini' (FES Sarajevo): 1% rate on estimated wealth of KM 114-218 billion would yield KM 1.14-2.18 billion
quote_original: Oporezivanje bogatstva je veoma važan mehanizam u ispravljanju zala političke ekonomije neuspjele privatizacije u BiH
quote_en: Taxing wealth is a very important mechanism for correcting the ills of the failed privatisation in BiH.
source_title: Porez na bogatstvo u Bosni i Hercegovini: novi put ka pravednosti i demokratizaciji
publisher: Friedrich-Ebert-Stiftung, Ured u Bosni i Hercegovini
grading_note: Authored publication recommending a wealth tax with a worked rate and revenue estimate.
